items.title: Moderna, Humana and Elanco Earnings Previews: What Investors Should Watch
items.summary: One stock has soared more than sevenfold this year, another just lost a quarter of its value on leaked data, and a third carries the fate of millions of retirees. Friday's earnings could test each rally in very different ways.

items.title: Fiserv (FISV) Adds Raj Seshadri to Board in Payments and Data Push
items.summary: Fiserv (NasdaqGS:FISV) has appointed Raj Seshadri, a former senior executive at Mastercard, to its Board of Directors. Seshadri brings experience leading commercial payments and data-focused businesses, alongside prior leadership roles at BlackRock and other financial institutions. Her background aligns with Fiserv's focus on unified commerce and embedded fintech as the board continues to evolve its mix of skills.
